metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the Rust CLI in [main.rs](/workspace/output/src/main.rs) with an empty dependency manifest in [Cargo.toml](/workspace/output/Cargo.toml). The tool parses `.bib`, `.bst`, `--cites`/`--aux`, executes the BibTeX-style stack language, writes `.bbl` output with line wrapping, and emits the requested JSON log or error JSON.

Verified with `cargo build --release`, `cargo test --release`, and a smoke test using `plain.bst` plus a small `.bib` sample through `cargo run --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml -- ...`. A system `bibtex` binary was not available here, so I could not do byte-for-byte oracle comparison against the historic executable in this environment.
